title: Debug integer overflow in Rust Fibonacci — 3 turns
description: Fibonacci function uses u32 and panics on overflow for large inputs. Fix with u64, run tests, add overflow-safe API.

task_spec.prompt: The `fibonacci` function uses `u32` and will overflow for `n >= 47`. Change the return type to `u64` (and the recursive calls accordingly). The test `test_large_fibonacci` expects `fibonacci(50) == 12586269025` which doesn't fit in u32. Also update the test assertions to expect u64 values. Run `cargo test --quiet`.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` to check the current state. Walk me through the fixes you made. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.

Final step: implement `fibonacci_checked(n: u32) -> Option<u64>` using iterative computation with `checked_add` — return None if any intermediate addition overflows. Run `cargo test --quiet` — all 4 tests must pass.
success_criteria: fibonacci() uses u64 return type to handle n >= 47
fibonacci_checked returns None for n >= 94 (u64 overflow)
